# Nationwide Slow Data and Traffic Dip Incident Report

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `CORE-DNS-01`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of software upgrade changes shortly before the KPI deviations on CORE-DNS-01 and CORE-UPF-01, confirmed anomaly onset timing, and ruled out maintenance and external events.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-03 13:15 to 2026-09-03 15:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-03 12:14
- **Affected:** CORE-DNS-01, CORE-UPF-01, S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-004

## Summary

Software upgrades on core nodes CORE-DNS-01 and CORE-UPF-01 caused core degradation leading to nationwide slow data and traffic dip.

Nationwide slow data and traffic dip affecting 48 sites and core nodes, starting at 2026-09-03 13:15 and recovering by 2026-09-03 15:45.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-03 12:14: Software upgrade patch 21.4.2 -> 21.4.3 on CORE-DNS-01 (resolver service restart) [CHG-2026-0003]
- 2026-09-03 12:16: Software upgrade patch 21.4.2 -> 21.4.3 on CORE-UPF-01 (service restart) [CHG-2026-0004]
- 2026-09-03 13:15: Anomaly alert ALR-0001 begins, indicating nationwide slow data and traffic dip affecting 48 sites and core nodes [ALR-0001, T1]
- 2026-09-03 13:15: CORE-DNS-01 query_success_pct drops below baseline [T4]

## Evidence

- A software upgrade was performed on CORE-DNS-01 at 2026-09-03 12:14. [CHG-2026-0003]
- A software upgrade was performed on CORE-UPF-01 at 2026-09-03 12:16. [CHG-2026-0004]
- Nationwide incident alert ALR-0001 started at 2026-09-03 13:15 affecting 48 sites, CORE-DNS-01, and CORE-UPF-01. [ALR-0001]
- CORE-DNS-01 showed query_success_pct below baseline starting at 2026-09-03 13:15. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on CORE-DNS-01, CORE-UPF-01 or their parents between 2026-09-03 10:00 and 18:00. [T3]
- No external events occurred between 2026-09-03 12:00 and 18:00. [T8]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at CORE-DNS-01: confirmed. Software upgrades on core nodes closely precede the nationwide slow data and DNS query success degradation. [CHG-2026-0003, CHG-2026-0004, T4]
2. **planned_maintenance**: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled during the incident window. [T3]

## Ruled out

- T3: No maintenance window was scheduled during the incident window.
- T8: No external events were recorded across all regions during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Review software patch 21.4.3 for potential regression issues on core resolver and UPF services.
- Verify stability metrics post-upgrade before wide deployment.

confounders.why: Harmless software_upgrade on CORE-DNS-01 completed 56 min before the degradation; the DNS KPIs stayed normal until the onset and the same patch on other core nodes did nothing.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; CORE-DNS-01 degraded for about 159 min; nationwide latency up, volume down, RRC unaffected. No alarm was raised; the evidence is in core_kpis. Trap: a software upgrade on CORE-DNS-01 itself ran 56 min before the onset, so a hasty investigator blames the change. Settled by: (1) the DNS and RRC KPIs were normal for 56 min after the upgrade, while a configuration change takes effect at once; (2) the same patch under the same ticket went onto CORE-AMF-01 and CORE-UPF-01 at the same time and both stayed healthy; (3) the degradation ended by itself, with no rollback or other change at the recovery.
